cards.name: Mew
cards.description: This Pokémon's body is covered by fine hairs that can be seen only under a microscope.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: This gentle Pokémon can understand human language and allows people to ride on its back.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: This Pokémon has a unique cry, as all three of its heads are always talking independently of one another.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.description: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: This Pokémon only calms down when there are no other animals or people around—which means no one has ever seen it when it's not angry.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.description: This Pokémon searches for food while flying at Mach 2. Its large claws make fearsome weapons.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: This Pokémon burrows through the earth at high speed, looking for food. The tunnels it digs are used by Diglett as nests.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: This Pokémon is still immature. When threatened, it releases poison from its head and tries to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: A sure sign spring is on its way is when the seed on this Pokémon's back flowers.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: This Pokémon sometimes hunts for food in rivers, swimming using the small webs between the toes on its rear legs.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.description: When it senses enemies approaching, this Pokémon releases an orange fluid from the joints in its legs and flees.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.
